trigger.description: Create a service to handle webhook events from HubSpot

metadata.label: Event Channel
metadata.description: The type of HubSpot CRM object event to listen for

section.label: Listener
section.description: Attach the service to a new or existing HubSpot webhook listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new HubSpot webhook listener in the project.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to a HubSpot listener already declared in the project.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing listener to attach the service to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Webhook Listener Port
metadata.description: The port on which the webhook listener accepts incoming HTTP requests

metadata.label: Listener Config
metadata.description: Fallback empty value for the listener config record when no fields under it are set.

metadata.label: Webhook Secret
metadata.description: Secret used to validate incoming HubSpot webhook requests

metadata.label: Callback URL
metadata.description: Configurable value referenced by the webhook signature verification DSL

metadata.label: Ticket
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot ticket is received. Available actions: onTicketPropertyChange, onTicketDeletion, onTicketCreation, onTicketMerge, onTicketRestore, and onTicketAssociationChange.

metadata.label: Company
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot company is received. Available actions: onCompanyDeletion, onCompanyRestore, onCompanyMerge, onCompanyPropertyChange, onCompanyCreation, and onCompanyAssociationChange.

metadata.label: Line Item
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot line item is received. Available actions: onLineItemMerge, onLineItemDeletion, onLineItemPropertyChange, onLineItemRestore, onLineItemAssociationChange, and onLineItemCreation.

metadata.label: Product
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot product is received. Available actions: onProductPropertyChange, onProductDeletion, onProductMerge, onProductRestore, and onProductCreation.

metadata.label: Conversation
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot conversation is received. Available actions: onConversationCreation, onConversationPropertyChange, onConversationPrivacyDeletion, onConversationNewMessage, and onConversationDeletion.

metadata.label: Deal
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot deal is received. Available actions: onDealDeletion, onDealCreation, onDealMerge, onDealPropertyChange, onDealRestore, and onDealAssociationChange.

metadata.label: Contact
metadata.description: Triggered when an event related to HubSpot contact is received. Available actions: onContactCreation, onContactAssociationChange, onContactDeletion, onContactPrivacyDeletion, onContactPropertyChange, onContactMerge, and onContactRestore.
